hook: A text-to-image model trained for under 55 dollars.

beats.say: A new arXiv paper, Asuka-FM, trains a 206-million-parameter diffusion transformer from scratch on a single RTX 4090.
Training took about 160 hours at 512 pixels, for under fifty-five dollars. The author calls it a micro-budget baseline for foundation models, with the best DPG score for its compute.
It reaches 0.609 on GenEval and 78.51 on DPG, by tackling attention costs, compilation graph breaks and the autoencoder bottleneck on consumer hardware.
